title: Cairn: An Adaptable Framework for Scientist-AI Research Software Teams
description: Cairn is a methodology for scientist-led research-software teams adopting AI agents: an invariant doctrine of recorded, reviewed deliberation; forkable templates; a single-agent bootstrap that adapts the apparatus along codebase and team dimensions; and two worked case studies (modflow_tools and LHM).
